title: Serene Yoga & Meditation Workshop Poster
summary: This prompt generates a serene and calming poster for a weekend yoga and meditation workshop. It features a soft-focus photograph of a person in a peaceful yoga pose at sunrise, evoking peace and wellness.
prompt: A serene and calming poster for a weekend yoga and meditation workshop. The main visual is a beautiful, soft-focus photograph of a person in a peaceful yoga pose on a beach at sunrise.
